cnTitle: 紫微斗数不同流派说法不一怎么取舍：三合、飞星、中州各管什么
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu Schools Compared: How to Choose Between San He, Flying Star and Zhongzhou
enDesc: Different Zi Wei Dou Shu schools read the same chart differently: San He stresses star combinations, Flying Star stresses palace-stem transformations, and Zhongzhou stresses star-system structure. Learn what each does well, then choose by your question instead of panicking at conflicting answers.
cnDesc: 同一个盘，三合派重星曜组合、飞星派重宫干四化、中州派重星系结构，结论常常不一样。先分清各自擅长回答什么，再按问题取法，而不是听到两种说法就慌。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数双星同宫和独坐怎么查：先在自己盘上认出星曜组合
enTitle: How to Identify Paired and Solo Major Stars in Your Zi Wei Dou Shu Chart
enDesc: Major stars sometimes share a palace as a pair and sometimes sit solo, and the readings differ greatly. Beginners should first learn to identify which arrangement their chart holds before studying star traits; do not reverse the order.
cnDesc: 十四主星在同一宫有时两颗同宫、有时一颗独坐，组合不同读法完全两样。新手先学会在自己盘上认出是哪一种组合，再谈星性，顺序别搞反。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命宫三方无吉星会照怎么读：没有吉扶不等于差命
enTitle: Reading a Zi Wei Dou Shu Life Palace with No Auspicious Meetings: Unsupported Is Not Doomed
enDesc: When the Life Palace triple-direction shows no auspicious stars such as Zuo Fu You Bi, Kui Yue, Chang Qu or Lu Cun, it is often called hopeless. In fact, lacking support only means fewer tailwinds, and malefics can instead forge drive; the key is the star nature and how the person lives it.
cnDesc: 命宫三方四正见不到左辅右弼、魁钺、昌曲、禄存等吉星，常被叫成「无救」。其实没有吉扶只代表少了顺风，煞星反而可能倒逼出执行力，关键看星性与后天怎么走。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命盘描述的是概率区间不是定局：怎么理解「倾向」
enTitle: A Zi Wei Dou Shu Chart Describes Probability Ranges, Not Fixed Outcomes: Understanding Tendency
enDesc: A chart gives tendencies and probability ranges under a star combination, not a fixed list of events. With the same structure, some land at the top of the range and others at the bottom; the difference is choice and action.
cnDesc: 命盘给的是星曜组合下的倾向与概率区间，不是逐条兑现的事件清单。同样的结构，有人落在区间上端、有人落在下端，差别就在选择与行动。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数和西方占星有什么不同：两套体系看的不是一回事
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu vs Western Astrology: Two Systems Reading Different Things
enDesc: Western astrology centers on planets in the twelve zodiac signs and their aspects, while Zi Wei Dou Shu centers on symbolic stars in twelve human-affairs palaces and the four transformations—one stresses planetary psychology, the other palace-based affairs; choose by your question.
cnDesc: 西方占星以行星落入黄道十二宫与相位为主，紫微以虚拟星曜落入十二人事宫与四化为主，一个重行星心理、一个重宫位人事，按问题选择即可。

cnTitle: 武曲贪狼在命宫：务实与欲望并存，沉住气反而走得远
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tan Lang in the Life Palace: Pragmatism Meets Appetite, and Patience Goes Further
enDesc: Wu Qu is the pragmatic wealth star and Tan Lang the versatile, desirous star. People with both in the Life Palace want both money and stimulation, with many opportunities and wide networks, but impatience brings boom-and-bust; later and steadier success usually holds better.
cnDesc: 武曲是务实财星、贪狼是多才多欲之星，两星同宫的人既想赚钱又爱折腾，机会多、交际广，但若沉不住气容易横冲横破，晚发通常更稳。

cnTitle: 天机巨门在命宫：善思善辩的人，怎么把口才用对地方
enTitle: Tian Ji and Ju Men in the Life Palace: Turning a Quick Mind and Sharp Tongue to the Right Use
enDesc: Tian Ji thinks quickly and Ju Men argues well; people with both in the Life Palace are fast, articulate and studious, building a place through expression and learning. But an unmanaged tongue or overthinking easily brings friction through words and drains within.
cnDesc: 天机善思、巨门善辩，两星同宫的人脑子快、口才好、爱钻研，靠表达与学问立身；但若管不住嘴、想太多，容易多言招尤、内耗伤身。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天厨在命宫：有口福、懂供养，也主稳定俸禄
enTitle: Tian Chu in the Life Palace: A Taste for Good Food, Nurturing and a Steady Stipend
enDesc: Tian Chu, the food-and-stipend star, in the Life Palace often gives a good appetite, a care for food and a generous manner, while also indicating steady provision and work related to food or salary—though not great wealth by itself.
cnDesc: 天厨又名食禄星，落命宫的人多有口福、讲究吃、待人厚道，也主一生供养不缺、适合与饮食、俸禄相关的稳定行当，但不直接等于大富。

cnTitle: 2026天同化禄落十二宫怎么读：福气、合作与被善待的资源落在哪
enTitle: How to Read Tian Tong Hua Lu Across the Twelve Palaces in 2026
enDesc: In the 2026 Bing Wu year, Tian Tong carries Hua Lu, governing blessings, harmony and resources that come through goodwill. Whichever palace it lands in finds goodwill and cooperation more readily, but the Lu is an opportunity, not a free ride; you still have to receive it.
cnDesc: 2026丙午年天同化禄，主福气、人和与「被善待」的资源。它落在哪个宫，哪个领域就更容易遇到善意与合作，但禄是机会不是坐享，仍要自己接住。

cnTitle: 2026天机化权落十二宫怎么读：变动中的主导权与规划力
enTitle: How to Read Tian Ji Hua Quan Across the Twelve Palaces in 2026
enDesc: In the 2026 Bing Wu year, Tian Ji carries Hua Quan, governing taking charge within change, setting the pace, planning and adapting. Whichever palace it lands in calls on you to decide actively there, but the Quan also carries responsibility, and rushing it breeds anxiety.
cnDesc: 2026丙午年天机化权，主在变化中拿主意、掌节奏，善规划、能应变。它落在哪宫，哪个领域就更需要你主动决策，但权也带责任，用急了易焦虑。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数科忌同宫怎么读：因事得名，也容易因名受累
enTitle: Reading Hua Ke and Hua Ji in One Palace: Recognition That Can Also Weigh You Down
enDesc: Hua Ke governs reputation, easing and recognition, while Hua Ji governs concern, lessons and entanglement. With both in one palace, a person often becomes known in a field through diligence, yet is also weighed down by that recognition and attachment; the key is the net effect.
cnDesc: 化科主名声、缓和与被认可，化忌主牵挂、课题与纠缠，两象同宫时，一个人常在某领域因认真而出名，也因这份名声与执着而受累，关键看净效果。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化权在交友宫：在朋友与团队里争主导，也担组织的责任
enTitle: Hua Quan in the Friends Palace: Leading Among Friends and Teams While Carrying the Group’s Responsibility
enDesc: Hua Quan in the Friends Palace makes one the decision-maker among friends, teams and subordinates, with strong organizing ability, but it is also easy to carry the group’s affairs personally; guard against unclear authority and the urge to win.
cnDesc: 化权落交友宫（奴仆宫），一个人在朋友圈、团队与下属中容易成为拿主意的人，组织能力强，但也容易把团队的事扛上身，要防权责不清与好胜。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数贪武同行格：武曲贪狼同度，为什么偏晚成
enTitle: The Tan Wu Tong Xing Pattern in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Wu Qu and Tan Lang Together Tend to Mature Late
enDesc: Tan Wu Tong Xing means Wu Qu and Tan Lang guarding together, often in Chou or Wei; the wealth star meets appetite, bringing early socializing, swings and restlessness. After midlife, if fire stars or Lu turn that appetite into enterprise, it steadies—a classic late-blooming pattern.
cnDesc: 贪武同行指武曲贪狼同守（多在丑未），财星遇上欲望，早年多应酬折腾、成败起伏，中年后若见火铃或禄星把欲望化为开拓，反而越走越稳，是典型晚成格。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数百官朝拱格：帝星得辅佐，有班底才成得了事
enTitle: The Hundred Officials Court the Ruler Pattern in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Emperor Star Needs Its Court
enDesc: Hundred Officials Court the Ruler means Zi Wei in the Life Palace with auspicious stars such as Zuo Fu You Bi, Tian Kui Tian Yue, Wen Chang Wen Qu and Lu Cun Tian Ma meeting its triple-direction, indicating support, skill in using people and real accomplishment. Without them it falls to a lone ruler; the pattern’s truth rests on actual meetings.
cnDesc: 百官朝拱指紫微坐命而三方四正得左辅右弼、天魁天钺、文昌文曲、禄存天马等吉星会照，主有辅佐、善用人、能成事；若无百官，则降为孤君，格局真假要看会照实数。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天官在官禄宫：适合走制度内文职与管理路线
enTitle: Tian Guan in the Career Palace: Suited to Institutional, Civil and Management Tracks
enDesc: Tian Guan governs official standing, order and civil reputation; in the Career Palace one works by rules and suits institutional, administrative or professional advisory tracks, with steady but gradual advancement; it should not be read as instant elevation.
cnDesc: 天官主官贵、秩序与文职名声，落官禄宫的人做事讲规矩、适合体制内、行政管理或专业幕僚路线，升迁稳但偏渐进，不宜把它读成一步登天。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天巫在官禄宫：升迁、传承与靠专业立身的事业
enTitle: Tian Wu in the Career Palace: Advancement, Lineage and a Career Built on Expertise
enDesc: Tian Wu governs intuition, advancement, inheritance and an affinity for metaphysics; in the Career Palace one readily gains sponsorship at work and suits succession or research, consulting and cultural professional tracks, with promotions often carrying the tone of being chosen by a senior.
cnDesc: 天巫主直觉、升迁、继承与玄学缘分，落官禄宫的人事业上易得提携、适合接棒传承或研究、咨询、文化类专业路线，升迁常带「被前辈点中」的味道。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年化忌入命宫：向内修的一年，怎么过不内耗
enTitle: When the Annual Hua Ji Enters Your Life Palace: A Year of Inner Work Without Self-Drain
enDesc: When the year-stem Hua Ji lands in the annual Life Palace (coinciding with the natal Life Palace), one tends toward high self-standards, repeated reflection and inward emotion that year—a year of inner work rather than outer events turning bad; directing the energy to refining oneself actually produces results.
cnDesc: 流年天干化忌落在流年命宫（与本命宫同位），这一年人容易对自己要求高、反复琢磨、情绪内收，是「向内修」的年份，而非外事变坏；把劲用在打磨自己上，反而出活。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限走天府这十年：库藏、稳守与家底积累期
enTitle: The Decade Through Tian Fu: A Ten-Year Period of Storage, Stewardship and Building Foundations
enDesc: When the decade Life Palace falls on Tian Fu, the stage emphasizes consolidation, accumulation and settling; resources must both come in and be retained. It suits building foundations and steadying the platform, rather than aggressive expansion during these ten years.
cnDesc: 十年大限命宫落天府，主这一阶段重在守成、积累与安顿，资源偏「进得来也要留得住」，适合沉淀家底、稳固平台，不宜在这十年冒进铺摊。

cnTitle: 武曲七杀在财帛宫：赚钱敢拼大单，也要防财来财去
enTitle: Wu Qu and Qi Sha in the Wealth Palace: Bold for Big Deals While Guarding Against Easy Come, Easy Go
enDesc: Wu Qu is the wealth star and Qi Sha the general star; together in the Wealth Palace, the earning style is hard-edged, bold for big deals and able to take money through competition, but money arrives and leaves fast. The key is whether storehouse stars and planning retain it.
cnDesc: 武曲是财星、七杀是将星，两星同入财帛，赚钱风格硬、敢接大单、能在竞争中取财，但钱来得猛去得也快，关键看有没有库星与规划把钱留住。

cnTitle: 紫微贪狼在疾厄宫：应酬多、节奏满，身体最需要给欲望设边界
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tan Lang in the Health Palace: A Full Social Schedule and the Body’s Need for Boundaries
enDesc: Zi Wei is the emperor star and Tan Lang governs appetite and socializing; together in the Health Palace, the body is often tied to entertaining, late nights and rich food, with attention to liver-gallbladder metabolism and cardiovascular load. This is a tendency, not a diagnosis; regular rest and tempered socializing are key.
cnDesc: 紫微是帝星、贪狼主欲望交际，两星同入疾厄，身体常与应酬、熬夜、饮食丰盛绑定，肝胆代谢与心血管负担要留意；倾向非诊断，规律作息、节制应酬是关键。

cnTitle: 紫微贪狼在迁移宫：在外多彩、机会多，也要防应酬与分心
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tan Lang in the Travel Palace: Colorful Opportunities Away from Home, with Guard Against Distraction
enDesc: Zi Wei and Tan Lang guarding Travel gives presence and sociability in front of outsiders, with many opportunities and romantic possibilities, suiting outward and networking-driven paths; but a too-colorful outer world easily distracts and drains; the key is whether the natal self can stay focused.
cnDesc: 紫微贪狼同守迁移，在外人面前有气场、善交际、机会与桃花都偏多，适合外向型、应酬型发展；但外面世界太热闹也易分心、耗神，关键看本命能否收得住。

cnTitle: 天机巨门在交友宫：朋友多是脑力型，沟通好也要防口舌
enTitle: Tian Ji and Ju Men in the Friends Palace: Intellectual Friends and Strong Communication, with Guard for Words
enDesc: Tian Ji and Ju Men guarding Friends fills the circle with thoughtful, articulate people, gathering others through discussion and exchange, suiting learning-oriented and creative teams; but too many words easily spark debate, so guard against friction through speech.
cnDesc: 天机巨门同守交友，朋友圈里多爱思考、善表达的人，靠讨论与交流聚人，适合带学习型、创意型团队；但话说多了也易起争辩，要防因言失和。

cnTitle: 武曲贪狼在官禄宫：生意头脑加交际手腕，事业贵在收束欲望
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tan Lang in the Career Palace: Business Acumen Meets Social Skill, and Success Rests on Focusing Appetite
enDesc: Wu Qu and Tan Lang guarding Career combines pragmatic management with social skill, suiting marketing, business, trade and entertaining-driven commerce with many opportunities; but overreaching for speed scatters focus, and only concentrating appetite onto the main business makes it large and durable.
cnDesc: 武曲贪狼同守官禄，事业上既讲务实经营、又善交际张罗，适合市场、商务、贸易与应酬型生意，机会多；但贪多求快易分散，把欲望收束到主业才做得大、守得住。

cnTitle: 天机太阴在福德宫：心思细、感受丰，怎么让敏感变成滋养
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tai Yin in the Karma Palace: A Fine Mind and Rich Feelings, Turning Sensitivity into Nourishment
enDesc: Tian Ji thinks quickly and Tai Yin is refined; together guarding Karma, the inner world is rich with strong aesthetics and sensitivity, suiting literary, artistic and planning interests; but overthinking and fine feelings also easily drain within, so giving the mind a place to settle is key.
cnDesc: 天机善思、太阴细腻，两星同守福德，内心世界丰富、审美与感受力强，适合文艺、规划类爱好；但想太多、感受太细也易内耗，给心思一个安放处是关键。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数福德宫看幸福感：满足从哪来、被什么悄悄消耗
enTitle: Reading Happiness Through the Zi Wei Dou Shu Karma Palace: Where Contentment Comes From and What Quietly Drains It
enDesc: The Karma Palace shows spiritual enjoyment and inner contentment: interests, leisure and aesthetics are sources of happiness, while inability to let go, wanting what is unreachable and being unable to rest drain it. Reading this palace tells you what genuinely makes you happy.
cnDesc: 福德宫看一个人精神享受与内心满足：兴趣、悠闲、审美是幸福感来源，想不开、求不得、闲不住则是消耗。读懂这一宫，才知道自己靠什么真正开心。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数迁移宫深度：外出发展的舞台、节奏与外部资源
enTitle: An In-Depth Reading of the Zi Wei Dou Shu Travel Palace: The Stage, Pace and Resources Away from Home
enDesc: The Travel Palace covers not only travel and relocation but one’s stage, connections and opportunities in the outer world: whether things go smoothly outside and one can accomplish through the outer world must be read with the natal self and triple-direction; one palace alone is unreliable.
cnDesc: 迁移宫不只看出差远行，更看一个人在外部世界的舞台、人缘与机会：在外顺不顺、能不能靠外面成事，要合本命与三方一起读，单宫断不准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数月在疾厄宫：体质偏敏感，怎么把小毛病管在前面
enTitle: Tian Yue in the Health Palace: A Sensitive Constitution and Managing Minor Ailments Early
enDesc: Tian Yue, the Illness Tally, in the Health Palace indicates a sensitive constitution prone to minor and chronic ailments and fine awareness of bodily changes. It is a tendency, not a diagnosis; regular rest, periodic check-ups and early management matter most.
cnDesc: 天月又名病符，落疾厄宫主体质偏敏感、小毛病、慢性病容易找上门，也主对身体变化感受细。它是倾向不是诊断，规律作息、定期体检、早做管理最关键。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天巫在田宅宫：祖荫、继承与家传缘分
enTitle: Tian Wu in the Property Palace: Ancestral Blessing, Inheritance and Family Legacy
enDesc: Tian Wu governs inheritance, intuition and lineage; in the Property Palace it indicates ties to family assets, ancestral blessing, heirlooms or family learning, and possibly inherited property or carrying on family affairs; but inheritance carries responsibility, so distinguish a resource from a burden.
cnDesc: 天巫主继承、直觉与传承，落田宅宫主与家产、祖荫、家传之物或家学有缘，也可能继承房产、接棒家事；但继承带责任，要分辨是资源还是担子。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数解神在夫妻宫：会解开纠缠，也要防关系说散就散
enTitle: Jie Shen in the Spouse Palace: Untangling Entanglements, with Guard Against Bonds Loosening Too Easily
enDesc: Jie Shen governs resolving, relieving and untying; in the Spouse Palace one is good at communication and reconciliation in a relationship and can dissolve conflicts, but it is also easy to untie a disagreement into a separation; when problems arise, do not rush to release—talk it through first.
cnDesc: 解神主化解、解围与「解开」，落夫妻宫主在关系里擅长沟通转圜、能化解矛盾，但也容易把分歧「解开」成分开，遇到问题别急着松手，先谈清楚。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数解神在田宅宫：家里的僵局能化解，也主住处常调整
enTitle: Jie Shen in the Property Palace: Resolving Household Deadlocks and Frequent Adjustments at Home
enDesc: Jie Shen in Property means skill at resolving household conflicts and handling living problems, often untying home matters through moving, renovation or reorganizing; but too-frequent adjustments bring instability, and major title decisions need care.
cnDesc: 解神落田宅，主善于化解家中矛盾、处理居住难题，也常通过搬家、装修、整理来「解开」居家问题；但住处调整太频也不安稳，重大产权处置要慎重。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天寿在命宫：稳重、耐久，像慢工出细活的人
enTitle: Tian Shou in the Life Palace: Steady, Enduring and Built for Slow, Careful Work
enDesc: The Tian Shou star governs longevity, steadiness and endurance; in the Life Palace one is stable, patient and able to stand the test of time, with solid bodily roots; but one is slow to warm and conservative and must guard against dragging, usually with ample staying power.
cnDesc: 天寿星主寿元、稳重与耐久，落命宫的人性子稳、有耐心、做事经得起时间，身体根基也偏扎实；但偏慢热保守，节奏上要防拖，后劲通常很足。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天德在福德宫：心善、宽厚，精神上自有逢凶化吉的底气
enTitle: Tian De in the Karma Palace: A Kind, Generous Heart with an Inner Gift for Turning Misfortune Around
enDesc: Tian De governs virtue, generosity and turning misfortune around; in the Karma Palace one is kind-hearted and forgiving with inner grounding, and in hardship help often appears or one can console oneself; but do not let good temper become boundless tolerance—kindness should carry judgment.
cnDesc: 天德主德行、宽厚与逢凶化吉，落福德宫主心地善良、待人宽厚、精神上有底气，遇到难事常有人帮、也能自我宽慰；但别把好脾气用成无底线，善良要带分寸。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数看跨行业转行时机：转行不是跳槽，先过这四道判断
enTitle: Timing a Cross-Industry Change in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Switching Fields Is Not Job Hopping
enDesc: Switching fields means changing track and skill set, a bigger risk than changing platforms. Check whether the Career star traits transfer, whether the Travel Palace offers new openings, and whether the decade and year activate the move; do not take being bored as a sign to switch.
cnDesc: 转行是换赛道、换能力圈，比换平台风险大。看官禄星性是否可迁移、迁移宫有没有新机会、大限流年是否引动，再判断什么时候走，别把「干腻了」当成「该转了」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数官禄宫看工作环境：你适合什么团队、节奏与角色
enTitle: Reading Work Environment Through the Career Palace: Team, Pace and Role That Fit You
enDesc: The Career Palace shows not only rank but the work environment that fits a person: team size, pace, independence and role. Reading these clearly helps you choose better and stay longer than chasing a title.
cnDesc: 官禄宫不只看职位高低，更看一个人适合什么工作环境：团队大小、节奏快慢、独立性与角色分工。读清这些，比盯着一个头衔找工作更能选得对、待得住。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数夫妻宫看在哪里认识另一半：把场景接到宫位上
enTitle: Reading Where You Meet Your Partner Through the Spouse Palace: Mapping Contexts to Palaces
enDesc: The Spouse Palace star combination can hint at the contexts where you more likely meet a partner: work, introductions, interest circles or travel. It gives tendencies, not addresses, and certainly does not guarantee the marriage year.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫的星曜组合，能提示更可能在什么场景里认识另一半：工作场合、熟人介绍、兴趣圈子还是异地旅途。它给的是倾向不是地址，更不保证结婚年份。

cnTitle: 武曲天府在夫妻宫：务实顾家的伴侣，感情落在柴米油盐里
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Fu in the Spouse Palace: A Practical, Home-Minded Partner and Love in Daily Life
enDesc: Wu Qu is the wealth star and Tian Fu the storehouse star; together guarding Spouse, the partner is practical, steady, good at daily life and focused on home and accumulation, with the bond sustained by responsibility; expression is reserved, so do not take lack of romance as lack of love.
cnDesc: 武曲是财星、天府是库星，两星同守夫妻，伴侣多务实稳重、会过日子、重视家庭与积累，关系靠责任与经营维系；但表达偏含蓄，别把不浪漫当成不深情。

cnTitle: 天机太阴在夫妻宫：细腻聪慧的伴侣，感情最怕想太多
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tai Yin in the Spouse Palace: A Delicate, Intelligent Partner and the Risk of Overthinking Love
enDesc: Tian Ji thinks quickly and Tai Yin is refined; together guarding Spouse, the partner is often bright, gentle, fine-minded and aesthetic, with the bond emphasizing spiritual exchange; but both are sensitive and prone to overthinking, easily fretting over small matters and quietly feeling wronged, so communication should be direct.
cnDesc: 天机善思、太阴细腻，两星同守夫妻，伴侣多聪明温柔、心思细、有审美，关系重精神交流；但双方都敏感、想得多，容易因小事琢磨、暗自委屈，沟通要直接。

cnTitle: 紫微天相在子女宫：孩子稳重懂事，亲子关系重规矩与陪伴
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tian Xiang in the Children Palace: Steady, Sensible Children and Parenting Through Rules and Presence
enDesc: Zi Wei is the emperor star and Tian Xiang the seal star; together guarding Children, the children are often steady, sensible, self-possessed and rule-aware, and one may also connect with students, juniors or long-term work; but discipline can turn strict and expectations high, so balance judgment with presence.
cnDesc: 紫微是帝星、天相是印星，两星同守子女，子女多稳重懂事、有主见、讲规矩，也可能与学生、晚辈、长期作品有缘；但管教易偏严、期待偏高，分寸与陪伴要平衡。

cnTitle: 廉贞天府在田宅宫：居家讲秩序，家是一点点经营出来的
enTitle: Lian Zhen and Tian Fu in the Property Palace: An Orderly Home Built Through Steady Care
enDesc: Lian Zhen governs rules and Tian Fu storage; together guarding Property, the family values order, accumulation and security, with skill at managing and tending the home and a steady living environment; but family members also favor rules and are reserved, so warmth must be expressed actively.
cnDesc: 廉贞主规则、天府主库藏，两星同守田宅，家庭重视秩序、积累与安全感，善于管家、顾家，居家环境稳；但家人之间也讲规矩、偏含蓄，温情要主动表达。

cnTitle: 武曲天府在父母宫：长辈务实可靠，亲子缘分重在互相担待
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Fu in the Parents Palace: Practical, Reliable Elders and a Bond Built on Mutual Care
enDesc: Wu Qu is the wealth star and Tian Fu the storehouse star; together guarding the Parents Palace, the elders are often practical, steady, home-minded and able to carry matters, and may help with material and practical problems; but expression is reserved, with few sweet words and love shown mainly through action.
cnDesc: 武曲是财星、天府是库星，两星同守父母宫，长辈多务实稳重、顾家能扛事，也可能在物质与实际问题上帮得上忙；但表达偏含蓄，亲子间少甜言，多靠行动见真情。
